## **Payments Tab**

On this tab, you map the payment methods configured in the Shopify store with the payment methods defined in Acumatica ERP. The **Store Payment Method** column is initially populated based on the settings from the Shopify store when the correct API credentials are entered and saved on the **General** tab.

Whenever a new payment method is created in the Shopify store, a row is automatically added to this table with the **Store Payment Method** column populated. You can add rows to the table by clicking **Add Row** on the table toolbar; you can also delete manually added rows from the table by clicking **Delete Row**. If you delete a row that was added to the table by the API, the deleted row will reappear when you click **Refresh** on the table toolbar or **Save** on the form toolbar.

The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see *Table [Toolbar](#page-645-1)*.

| Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| A check box that indicates (if selected) that payment processing is enabled for the pay<br>ment method.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| If this check box is cleared for a payment method, when an order is placed in the Shopi<br>fy store and this payment method is selected at checkout, the corresponding payment is<br>not imported from the Shopify store to Acumatica ERP.                                                                                     |
| This check box is cleared by default.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| The payment method defined in the Shopify store. This column is populated automati<br>cally. However, you can manually add additional mappings of payment options.                                                                                                                                                             |
| The currency for which the store payment method has been defined in the Shopify store.<br>You can select a currency from the list of active currencies defined on the Currencies<br>(CM202000) form. This column is filled in automatically for store payment methods that<br>are added to the table automatically by the API. |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

# **Shipping Tab**

In the table on this tab, you define the mapping of each shipping option (which is a combination of a shipping zone and shipping method) defined in Shopify to the ship via code, and optionally, shipping zone and shipping terms defined in Acumatica ERP. The **StoreShipping Zone** and **StoreShipping Method** columns of the table are populated with the settings from Shopify when the correct API credentials are entered and saved on the **General** tab. The list of mappings can be updated in the following ways:

- The system automatically adds the shipping options (store shipping zones and store shipping methods) to the table or removes them from the table based on the shipping options that are active in the Shopify store. You can make changes to the settings in the**Ship Via**, **Shipping Zone**, and **ShippingTerms** columns. However, you cannot remove the automatically added shipping options by using the **Delete Row** button on the table toolbar.
- You can manually add rows for active shipping options in the Shopify store by using the **Add Row** button on the table toolbar; you can also delete the manually added rows by using the **Delete Row** button on the table toolbar.
- The system automatically adds a shipping option to the table if during the import of sales orders, the shipping zone and the shipping method specified in a particular sales order are missing from the table.

| Column                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                       |
|-------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Active                  | A check box that indicates (if selected) that the system should use the mapped ship via,<br>shipping zone, and shipping terms when importing orders from the Shopify store.       |
| StoreShipping<br>Zone   | The shipping zone that has been set up in the Shopify store.                                                                                                                      |
| StoreShipping<br>Method | The shipping method for the specified shipping zone that has been set up in the Shopify<br>store.                                                                                 |
| Ship Via                | The Ship Via code in Acumatica ERP that is mapped to the combination of the store ship<br>ping zone and the store shipping method.                                                |
|                         | The value selected in this column is assigned to orders imported into Acumatica ERP and<br>is displayed on the Shipping tab of the Sales Orders (SO301000) form for these orders. |
|                         | If you click code, the system opens the Ship via Codes (CS207500) form, on which you can<br>review the Ship Via code's details.                                                   |

The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see *Table [Toolbar](#page-645-1)*.

The value selected in this column is assigned to each<br>sales order imported to Acumatica ERP with the store shipping zone and store shipping<br>method specified in this row. This value is also inserted on theShipping tab of the Sales<br>Orders (SO301000) form for the sales order.                        |

If you leave it empty, theShipping Zone box on theShipping tab<br>of the Sales Orders (SO301000) form will not be populated when a sales order with the<br>store shipping zone and store shipping method specified in the row is imported.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|               | If you click this identifier, the system opens the shipping zone on the Shipping Zones<br>(CS207510) form.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ShippingTerms | The identifier of the shipping terms in Acumatica ERP, which is defined on the Ship<br>ping Terms (CS208000) form, that is mapped to the combination of the store shipping<br>zone and store shipping method. The value selected in this column is assigned to each<br>sales order imported to Acumatica ERP with the store shipping zone and store shipping<br>method specified in this row. This value is also inserted in theShippingTerms box on the<br>Shipping tab of the Sales Orders (SO301000) form for the sales order. |

If you leave it empty, theShippingTerms box on theShipping tab<br>of the Sales Orders (SO301000) form will not be populated when a sales order with the<br>store shipping zone and store shipping method specified in the row is imported.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|               | If you click this identifier, the system opens the shipping terms on the Shipping Terms<br>(CS208000) form.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

# <span id="page-510-1"></span><span id="page-510-0"></span>**Amazon Stores**

Form ID: (BC201020)

You use this form to set up a connection to your Amazon seller account (which is referred to as a *store* in Acumatica ERP). Aer the connection has been established, on this form, you specify the marketplace settings, activate the entities that need to be synchronized between Acumatica ERP and the Amazon store, and define the synchronization settings for the active entities.

| • | This form is available only if the Retail Commerce and Amazon Connector features are enabled<br>on the Enable/Disable Features (CS100000) form. |
|---|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|   |                                                                                                                                                 |

• The number of Amazon seller accounts to which you can establish a connection on this form is limited by your license.

# **Form Toolbar**

The form toolbar includes standard and form-specific buttons and commands. For the list of standard buttons, see *Form [Toolbar](#page-638-1) and More Menu*. The form-specific commands are listed in the following table.

| Button    | Description                                                                                                                                                          |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Authorize | Invokes the Sign-In screen for the Amazon Seller Central, in which you provide the cre<br>dentials for the Amazon seller account and establish the connection to it. |

| Button          | Description                                                                                                                      |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Test Connection | By using the information specified on the General tab, tests the ability to connect to<br>the Amazon seller account via the API. |

#### **Summary Area**

In this area, you specify the basic settings of a particular Amazon store, or select a store to view and edit its settings.

| Element    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Connector  | A read-only box with the name of the ecommerce connector (Amazon) of a store con<br>figured on this form.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Store Name | The name of the Amazon store to which the connection is being established. The store<br>name is specified when the connection is first configured; you cannot change it later.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Active     | A check box that indicates (if selected) that the store configuration is active and the en<br>tities activated and configured for this store are synchronized between Acumatica ERP<br>and the Amazon store.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|            | For inactive stores, you can modify the store settings on the current form, but entities<br>are not synchronized; you can see the history of the synchronization of entities on the<br>Sync History (BC301000) form.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Default    | A check box that you select to indicate that this store is the default store in Acumatica<br>ERP.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|            | If multiple stores have been configured on this form, on the BigCommerce Stores<br>(BC201000) form, or on the Shopify Stores (BC201010) form, if applicable, when you<br>open other commerce-related forms, the store you have defined as the default is auto<br>matically inserted in the Store box.                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|            | The system requires a store to be defined as the default store. When you are defining<br>the first store in the system—on this form, on the BigCommerce Stores form, or on the<br>Shopify Stores form—this check box is selected automatically. When you define anoth<br>er store, this check box is cleared by default; if you select this check box for the store<br>being defined, the system clears this check box for the store that was previously de<br>fined as the default store. |

# **General Tab**

On this tab, you specify the information that is required to establish the connection to an Amazon seller account (that is, create a new Amazon store in Acumatica ERP), or view general settings of an existing Amazon store.

#### *Table: Connection Section*

This section contains the settings related to the region and marketplace to which the Acumatica ERP seller account belongs. You specify these settings before you can initiate establishing a connection to the Acumatica ERP seller account

| Element | Description                                            |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| Region  | The region to which the Amazon seller account belongs. |

| Element     | Description                                                 |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| Marketplace | The marketplace to which the Amazon seller account belongs. |

#### *Table: Miscellaneous Section*

| Element       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Locale        | The locale of Acumatica ERP to be synchronized with the Amazon seller account.<br>If multiple locales have been configured in Acumatica ERP and data is maintained in<br>multiple languages, in this box, you select the locale that will be synchronized with<br>the Amazon seller account.                                                |
| Administrator | The administrator of the Amazon store, which is the user who receives notifications<br>about aborted synchronization that are triggered by predefined business events.<br>For more information about predefined business events for aborted synchronization<br>records, see Automated Synchronization: Business Events for Aborted Records. |

#### *Table: License Restrictions Section*

| Element              | Description                                                                                                              |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Max. Number ofStores | The maximum number of Amazon stores that can be created in the Acumatica ERP<br>instance.                                |
|                      | The number of Amazon seller accounts to which you can establish a connection on<br>this form is limited by your license. |

#### **Entities Tab**

The table rows on this tab are automatically populated with the entities that can be synchronized between Acumatica ERP and the Amazon seller account. You can activate the entities that you need to synchronize between the systems; you can also view and specify synchronization settings for these entities.

The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see *Table [Toolbar](#page-645-1)*.

|  | Table: Table Columns |
|--|----------------------|
|  |                      |

| Column | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Active | A check box that indicates (if selected) that the entity is synchronized between<br>Acumatica ERP and the Amazon seller account.                                                                                                               |
|        | If an entity requires other entities to be synchronized along with it,<br>when you select this check box for the entity, the system also selects<br>the Active check box for these required entities.                                          |
| Entity | The entity that can be synchronized between Acumatica ERP and the Amazon seller<br>account, which is one of the following:<br>Product (Linking Only)<br>•<br>•<br>Product Availability<br>•<br>Sales Order<br>•<br>Marketplace-Fulfilled Order |

| Column         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|                | •<br>Sales Invoice (Obsolete)<br>•<br>Payment<br>•<br>Non-Order Fees<br>•<br>Shipment<br>•<br>Seller-Fulfilled Refund<br>•<br>Marketplace-Fulfilled Refund<br>•<br>Marketplace Transfer Order<br>•<br>Marketplace Transfer Receipt<br>You can click the link with each entity name to open the Entities (BC202000) form in a<br>pop-up window and specify the mapping and filtering settings for the entity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Sync Direction | The direction in which the entity should be synchronized. The direction can be either<br>of the following:<br>•<br>Export: Data is exported from Acumatica ERP to the Amazon seller account.<br>•<br>Import: Data is imported to Acumatica ERP from the Amazon seller account.<br>The direction of the synchronization is predefined by the system as follows:<br>•<br>Product (Linking Only), predefined as Import<br>•<br>Product Availability, predefined as Export<br>•<br>Sales Order, predefined as Import<br>•<br>Marketplace-Fulfilled Order, predefined as Import<br>•<br>Sales Invoice (Obsolete), predefined as Import<br>•<br>Payment, predefined as Import<br>•<br>Non-Order Fees, predefined as Import<br>•<br>Shipment, predefined as Export<br>•<br>Seller-Fulfilled Refund, predefined as Import<br>•<br>Marketplace-Fulfilled Refund, predefined as Import<br>•<br>Marketplace Transfer Order, predefined as Import<br>Marketplace Transfer Receipt, predefined as Import<br>• |
| Primary System | The system that is used as the source of data during the synchronization of entities.<br>If bidirectional synchronization is selected for the entity, the data of the primary<br>system takes precedence if any conflicts arise during the synchronization.<br>The primary system can be either of the following:<br>•<br>ERP (that is, Acumatica ERP)<br>•<br>External System (that is, the Amazon seller account)<br>The primary system is determined based on theSync Direction setting as follows:<br>•<br>For Export, ERP is set to be the primary system and cannot be changed.<br>•<br>For Import, External System is set to be the primary system and cannot be<br>changed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

| Column               | Description                                                                                                                                                           |
|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Max. Failed Attempts | The maximum number of errors allowed during the import or export of data before<br>the sync record is excluded from (that is, excluded from further synchronization). |
|                      | By default, the column contains 5: That is, the system allows 5 failed attempts be<br>fore excluding the synchronization record from further processing.              |

# **Inventory Tab**

On this tab, you can define which item quantities should be exported to the Amazon seller account.

#### *Table: Inventory Settings Section*

This section contains the settings related to the export of item availability information to the Amazon seller account.

| Element           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Availability Mode | The type of item quantity that is exported to the Amazon seller account during the<br>synchronization of the Product Availability entity. You can select one of the follow<br>ing options:                                                                                     |
|                   | Available: The item's available quantity in Amazon is based on the entire avail<br>•<br>able quantity of the item in Acumatica ERP.                                                                                                                                            |
|                   | •<br>Available for Shipping: The item's available quantity in Amazon is based on the<br>quantity available for shipping in Acumatica ERP.                                                                                                                                      |
|                   | •<br>On Hand: The item's available quantity in Amazon is based on the on-hand<br>quantity of the item in Acumatica ERP.                                                                                                                                                        |
|                   | For information about availability calculation in Acumatica ERP, see Availability Cal<br>culation Rules: General Information.                                                                                                                                                  |
| Warehouse Mode    | An option that determines whether all warehouses or specific warehouses and lo<br>cations are used for determining the available quantity of the item in the Amazon<br>seller account.                                                                                         |
|                   | You can select one of the following options:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                   | •<br>All Warehouses: The available quantity of the item is calculated based on the on<br>hand quantity of the item in all warehouses.                                                                                                                                          |
|                   | •<br>Specific Warehouses: The available quantity of the item is calculated based on<br>the on-hand quantity in the selected warehouses and warehouse locations. If<br>this option is selected, a list of warehouses and warehouse locations to be used<br>should be specified. |

If no location is selected, the system exports the availability data for items<br>stored in all locations of the selected warehouse.                                                                                                                                                                                              |

# <span id="page-521-1"></span><span id="page-521-0"></span>**Entities**

#### Form ID: (BC202000)

On this form, you specify the import and export settings for entities supported by the ecommerce connector. Additionally, you can configure filters to determine which data needs to be synchronized or excluded from the synchronization process. You can also use this form to define the rules for mapping Acumatica ERP fields to fields in the online store—for example, to map additional standard or custom fields or to override the default mapping.

![](_page_521_Picture_5.jpeg)

This form is available only if the *Retail Commerce* feature is enabled on the *[Enable/Disable Features](https://help-2025r1.acumatica.com/Help?ScreenId=ShowWiki&pageid=c1555e43-1bc5-4f6f-ba9d-b323f94d8a6b)* (CS100000) form.

### **Form Toolbar**

The form toolbar includes standard buttons and form-specific buttons and commands. For the list of standard buttons, see *Form [Toolbar](#page-638-1) and More Menu*. The form-specific commands can be shown as buttons on the form toolbar, as commands on the More menu, or in both places. These commands are listed in the following table in alphabetical order.

| Command                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|-------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ClearSync Data          | Opens the ClearSync Data dialog box, which you can use to delete all synchronization<br>information for the selected entity.                                                                                    |
| Start Real-Time<br>Sync | For the Export synchronization direction: Starts the real-time synchronization process<br>and sets the Real-Time Export status to Running for the selected entity.                                              |
|                         | For the Import and Bidirectional synchronization direction: Opens the Start Real-Time<br>Sync dialog box.                                                                                                       |
| Stop Real-Time<br>Sync  | Disables the real-time synchronization process and sets the Real-Time Export or Re<br>al-Time Import status, depending on the selected direction of the synchronization, to<br>Stopped for the selected entity. |

#### *Table: Start Real-Time Sync Dialog Box*

| Element                                             | Description                                                                                                                                                                  |  |

| The dialog box also contains the following buttons. |                                                                                                                                                                              |  |
| Continue                                            | Starts the real-time synchronization process, sets the Real-Time Import status to Run<br>ning for the selected entity, and closes the dialog box.                            |  |
| Cancel                                              | Closes the dialog box without starting real-time synchronization.                                                                                                            |  |

#### *Table: Clear Sync Data Dialog Box*

| The dialog box also contains the following buttons. |                                                                                                                                                            |

#### **Summary Area**

In this area, you can select a particular entity for which you want to configure field mapping and filtering rules that are applied when data is imported to Acumatica ERP or exported to the external system. The elements also display the general settings for the selected entity.

| Element   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

| Element        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Entity         | The name of the entity supported by the connector. The available options are the follow<br>ing, based on the entities for which the connector supports synchronization:                                                                                                                          |

|                | •<br>For Shopify: Customer, Company, Customer Location, Stock Item, Non-Stock Item, Tem<br>plate Item, Product Image, Product Availability, Sales Order, Payment, Shipment, Re<br>fund, Price List                                                                                               |
|                | •<br>For Amazon: Product (Linking Only), Product Availability, Sales Order, Marketplace-Ful<br>filled Order, Sales Invoice (Obsolete), Payment, Non-Order Fees, Shipment, Seller-Ful<br>filled Refund, Marketplace-Fulfilled Refund, Marketplace Transfer Order, Marketplace<br>Transfer Receipt |
| Active         | A read-only check box that indicates (if selected) that the entity has been activated (that<br>is, selected for synchronization) for the store on the BigCommerce Stores (BC201000),<br>Shopify Stores (BC201010), or Amazon Stores (BC201020) form.                                             |
| Sync Direction | The direction in which the entity should be synchronized, which can be one of the follow<br>ing:                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                | •<br>Export: Data is exported from Acumatica ERP to the external system.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|                | •<br>Import: Data is imported to Acumatica ERP from the external system.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|                | •<br>Bidirectional: Data is synchronized between Acumatica ERP and the external system in<br>both directions.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                | For the BigCommerce stores, the direction of the synchronization is inserted by the sys<br>tem and cannot be changed for the following entities:                                                                                                                                                 |
|                | Base Sales Price (predefined as Export)<br>•                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                | •<br>Price List (predefined as Export)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                | •<br>Product Image (predefined as Export)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                | •<br>Product Availability (predefined as Export)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                | •<br>Payment (predefined as Import)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                | •<br>Shipment (predefined as Export)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                | •<br>Refund (predefined as Import)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                | For the Shopify stores, the direction of the synchronization is inserted by the system and<br>cannot be changed for the following entities:                                                                                                                                                      |
|                | •<br>Product Image (predefined as Export)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                | •<br>Product Availability (predefined as Export)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                | •<br>Sales Order (predefined as Import)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                | •<br>Payment (predefined as Import)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                | •<br>Shipment (predefined as Export)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                | •<br>Refund (predefined as Import)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                | For the Amazon stores, the direction of the synchronization is inserted by the system and<br>cannot be changed for all the entities.                                                                                                                                                             |

| Element                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Primary System            | The system that is used as the source of data during the synchronization of entities. If<br>bidirectional synchronization is selected for the entity, the data of the primary system<br>takes precedence if any conflicts arise during the synchronization. |
|                           | The primary system can be either of the following:                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                           | •<br>ERP (that is, Acumatica ERP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                           | •<br>External System (that is, the external system)                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|                           | The primary system is determined based on the direction of the synchronization as fol<br>lows:                                                                                                                                                              |
|                           | •<br>For Export, ERP is set to be the primary system and cannot be changed.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                           | •<br>For Import, External System is set to be the primary system and cannot be changed.                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                           | •<br>For Bidirectional, you can select which system should be used as the primary system,<br>based on your synchronization processes.                                                                                                                       |
| Max. Failed At<br>tempts  | The maximum number of errors that are allowed during the import or export of data be<br>fore the synchronization record is skipped (that is, excluded from further synchroniza<br>tion).                                                                    |
|                           | By default, the box contains 5, indicating that the system allows five failed attempts be<br>fore excluding the synchronization record from further processing.                                                                                             |
| Real-Time Import          | The status of real-time import for the entity. The system inserts the status, which is one<br>of the following:                                                                                                                                             |
|                           | •<br>Stopped: Real-time synchronization is not started for the Import direction.                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                           | •<br>Running: Real-time synchronization is started for the Import direction.                                                                                                                                                                                |
|                           | •<br>Not Supported: Real-time synchronization is not supported for the Import direction.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Real-Time Export          | The status of real-time export for the entity. The system inserts the status, which is one of<br>the following:                                                                                                                                             |
|                           | •<br>Stopped: Real-time synchronization is not started for the Export direction.                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                           | •<br>Running: Real-time synchronization is started for the Export direction.                                                                                                                                                                                |
|                           | •<br>Not Supported: Real-time synchronization is not supported for the Export direction.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Real-Time Mode            | The mode of the processing of the synchronization records, which can be either of the<br>following:                                                                                                                                                         |
|                           | •<br>Prepare: As soon as a push notification about a change to data is received, the corre<br>sponding synchronization record is placed in the processing queue.                                                                                            |
|                           | •<br>Prepare & Process: As soon as a push notification about a change to data is received,<br>the corresponding synchronization record is placed in the processing queue, and the<br>data processing is immediately started for the synchronization record. |
| Real-Time Web<br>hook URL | The URL that has been specified for receiving push notifications from the external system<br>for the entity.                                                                                                                                                |

# **Import Mapping Tab**

By using the table on this tab, you configure the mapping of standard or custom fields to be used in import processing. This tab is displayed only if the *Import* direction is supported for the selected entity. You can use the drag-and-drop functionality to arrange rows of the table in the needed order.

The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see *Table [Toolbar](#page-645-1)*.

![](_page_525_Figure_2.jpeg)

| Column                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|---------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Active                    | A check box that indicates (if selected) that the import mapping rule is active.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ERP Object                | The object in Acumatica ERP whose field is set to the value of the external field or to a cal<br>culated value on import.<br>The list of available options depends on the selected entity.                                                                                                              |
| ERP Field                 | The field of the selected ERP object that is set to the value of the mapped external field or<br>a to calculated value on import.<br>The list of fields available for selection depends on the selected ERP object.                                                                                     |
| External Object           | The object in the external system whose field's value is assigned to the ERP field.<br>The list of available options depends on the selected entity and the ecommerce connec<br>tor.                                                                                                                    |
| External Field /<br>Value | The field of the external object whose value is assigned to the ERP field, or the expression<br>to be executed on import to generate the value that is assigned to the ERP field.<br>The list of available options depends on the selected entity, the ecommerce connector,<br>and the external object. |

#### **Import Filtering Tab**

By using the table on this tab, you can set up the rules according to which data will be included in or excluded from the import processing. This tab is displayed only if the *Import* direction is supported for the selected entity. You can use the drag-and-drop functionality to arrange rows of the table in the needed order.

Only data that matches the filtering conditions is included in the synchronization. See the subsequent sections for more information and examples of filtering conditions.

The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see *Table [Toolbar](#page-645-1)*.

#### *Table: Table Columns*

| Column           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Active           | A check box that indicates (if selected) that the condition is active and is used for filter<br>ing.                                                                                                                      |
| Opening Brackets | The opening bracket or brackets for enclosing a logical expression. Brackets are used to<br>designate the order of the operation within the rule. There can be up to five brackets (and<br>up to five levels of nesting). |
| Field Name       | The name of the field in the external system to which the filter will be applied.<br>The list of available options depends on the selected entity.                                                                        |

| Column           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Condition        | The logical operation to apply to the value of the selected field. The following options<br>are available: Equals, Does Not Equal, Is Greater Than, Is Greater Than or Equal To, Is Less<br>Than, Is Less Than or Equal To, Contains, Starts With, Ends With, Does Not Contain, Is Be<br>tween, Is Empty, Is Not Empty, Is Null, and Is Not Null. |
| Value            | The primary value of the condition to be compared with the value of the selected field.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Value 2          | The secondary value, if required by the selected condition. Most of the conditions require<br>only one value, while Is Between requires two values.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Closing Brackets | The closing bracket or brackets for enclosing a logical expression.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Operator         | The logical operator, And or Or, to be used to join logical expressions on different lines.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

| External Object   | The object in the external system whose field is set to the value of the ERP field or to a<br>calculated value on export.<br>The list of available options depends on the selected entity and the ecommerce connec |
|                   | tor.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| External Field    | The field of the selected external object that is set to the value of the ERP field or to a cal<br>culated value on export.                                                                                        |
|                   | The list of available options depends on the selected entity, the ecommerce connector,<br>and the external object.                                                                                                 |
| ERP Object        | The object in Acumatica ERP whose field's value is assigned to the external field on ex<br>port.                                                                                                                   |
|                   | The list of available options depends on the selected entity and the ecommerce connec<br>tor.                                                                                                                      |
| ERP Field / Value | The field of the selected ERP object whose value is assigned to the external field on ex<br>port, or the expression to be executed on export to generate the value that is assigned to<br>the external field.      |
|                   | The list of available options depends on the selected entity and the ERP object.                                                                                                                                   |

# **Export Filtering Tab**

| Opening Brackets | The opening bracket or brackets for enclosing a logical expression. Brackets are used to<br>designate the order of the operation within the rule. There can be up to five brackets (and<br>up to five levels of nesting).                                                                                                                            |
| Field Name       | The name of the field in Acumatica ERP to which the filter will be applied.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

The following options<br>are available: Equals, Does Not Equal, Is Greater Than, Is Greater Than or Equal To, Is Less<br>Than, Is Less Than or Equal To, Contains, Starts With, Ends With, Does Not Contain, Is Be<br>tween, Is Empty, Is Not Empty, Is Null, and Is Not Null. |

Most of the conditions require<br>only one value, while Is Between requires two values.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

# <span id="page-527-1"></span><span id="page-527-0"></span>**Attribute Mapping for Template Item Import**

#### Form ID: (BC203000)

On this form, you define the rules for mapping Acumatica ERP attributes and their values to product variants and their values from an external ecommerce system. These mappings are used while creating template items during product import from the external system.

The system adds rows to the table on the form aer product import is prepared from the external ecommerce system on the *[Prepare Data](#page-529-1)* (BC501000) form if the products to be imported have variants in the external system. The system deletes rows from the table on the form when the corresponding mappings are successfully used to create the template and matrix items.

![](_page_528_Picture_1.jpeg)

This form is available only if the *Retail Commerce* feature is enabled on the *[Enable/Disable Features](https://help-2025r1.acumatica.com/Help?ScreenId=ShowWiki&pageid=c1555e43-1bc5-4f6f-ba9d-b323f94d8a6b)* (CS100000) form.

# **Form Toolbar**

The form toolbar includes standard and form-specific buttons and commands. For the list of standard buttons, see *Form [Toolbar](#page-638-1) and More Menu*. The form-specific commands are listed in the following table.

| Button            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| View Attributes   | Opens the Attributes (CS205000) form in a pop-up window. You can use this form to review<br>and update existing attributes and their values, as well as to create new attributes and<br>values.                                                                                                                                             |
| Update Item Class | Populates the ERP Item Class column in the table with the item class selected in the<br>Item Class to Assign box in the Summary area for the selected row (that is, the row you<br>have clicked before clicking this button) and all the rows with the same identifier in the<br>External ID column as the external ID in the selected row. |

### **Summary Area**

In this area, you can select the item class to be assigned to the mappings shown in the table.

| Element          | Description                                                                            |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Item Class to As | The item class the system assigns to mappings shown in the table when you click Update |
| sign             | Item Class on the form toolbar.                                                        |

## **Table Toolbar**

The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see *Table [Toolbar](#page-645-1)*.

# **Table Columns**

This table contains pairs of values, with each row containing the original value that is being replaced and the substitute value that will be used instead of the original value.

| Column                   | Description                                                                                                                                   |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| External Descrip<br>tion | The product name (title) in the external ecommerce system.<br>The column is read-only.                                                        |
| External ID              | The product identifier in the external ecommerce system.<br>The column is read-only.                                                          |
| External Option          | The variant option of the product in the external ecommerce system that is set to the ERP<br>attribute on import.<br>The column is read-only. |

| Column                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|--------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| External Option<br>Value | The variant value in the external ecommerce system that is set to the ERP attribute value<br>on import.<br>The column is read-only.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ERP Item Class           | The item class to be assigned to each template item imported to Acumatica ERP from the<br>external ecommerce system. This item class will be used to provide its default settings.<br>You can select the item class manually; alternatively, you can click a row in the table and<br>then click Update Item Class on the form toolbar to automatically populate this column<br>with the item class selected in the Item Class to Assign box. The system also assigns the<br>inserted item class to all the rows with the same identifier in the External ID column as<br>the one in the updated row. |
| ERP Attribute            | The Acumatica ERP attribute that corresponds to the external product variant. This at<br>tribute has been defined on the Attributes (CS205000) form.<br>When you select a attribute, the system assigns the attribute to all the rows with the<br>same external identifier and external option as in the updated row.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ERP Attribute Val<br>ue  | The value of the Acumatica ERP attribute that corresponds to the value of the external<br>product variant. This attribute value has been defined on the Attributes (CS205000) form.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

# <span id="page-529-1"></span><span id="page-529-0"></span>**Prepare Data**

Form ID: (BC501000)

By using this form, you can manually start the data fetch process for a single entity or multiple entities. For details on the data fetch process, see *[Data Synchronization: General Information](#page-31-2)*.

![](_page_529_Picture_8.jpeg)

This form is available only if the *Retail Commerce* feature is enabled on the *[Enable/Disable Features](https://help-2025r1.acumatica.com/Help?ScreenId=ShowWiki&pageid=c1555e43-1bc5-4f6f-ba9d-b323f94d8a6b)* (CS100000) form.

### **Form Toolbar**

The form toolbar includes standard and form-specific buttons and commands. For the list of standard buttons, see *Form [Toolbar](#page-638-1) and More Menu*. The form-specific commands are listed in the following table.

| Button  | Description                                                                             |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Prepare | Starts the data preparation process for the entities you<br>have selected in the table. |

# **Selection Area**

By using the elements in this area, you can configure the data fetch process to be started for the entities in the table.

| Element      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Store        | The name of the online store.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|              | By default, the system inserts the store for which the<br>Default check box is selected on the BigCommerce<br>Stores(BC201000) or Shopify Stores (BC201010) form.                                                                                   |
| Entity       | The entity for which the data preparation process<br>should be started.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Prepare Mode | An indicator of which data should be pulled from<br>Acumatica ERP and the online store and placed in the<br>processing queue during the data preparation process.                                                                                   |
|              | You select either of the following options:                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|              | •<br>Incremental (default): Only document or entity<br>records that have been modified since the last<br>successful full or incremental data preparation<br>(whichever happened most recently) should be<br>pulled and put in the processing queue. |
|              | Incremental by Date: Document or entity records<br>•<br>are pulled and placed in the processing queue on<br>ly if they have been modified during the date range<br>specified in the Date Range box, and if they have<br>not been processed.         |
|              | •<br>Full: All document or entity records created or up<br>dated during the date range specified in the Date<br>Range should be pulled and placed in the process<br>ing queue, regardless of whether they have been<br>processed previously or not. |
| Date Range   | Records that have been modified in this date range are<br>prepared for synchronization.                                                                                                                                                             |
|              | The box is available for editing only if Incremental by<br>Date or Full is selected in the Prepare Mode box.                                                                                                                                        |

# **Table**

In this table, you can select the entities that should be prepared for synchronization and view the information about the previous data preparation processes, including the date and time of the previous full and incremental fetch, and the errors that occurred during the last data preparation attempt, if any.

The table toolbar includes only standard buttons. For the list of standard buttons, see *Table [Toolbar](#page-645-1)*.

#### *Table: Table Columns*

| Column           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
